Name: Animal Resource Crops
Author: Wizadroid
Description:
[center][img]https://i.postimg.cc/yNQkfRx9/mod-details.png[/img]
Want animal products without needing to care for animals? Well here's your answer! With Animal Resource Crops you can grow crops corresponding to their animal and process their produce into their animal products.

Currently included are all vanilla animals:
Cows (Bovine Melons)
Chickens (Poultryberries)
Dinosaurs (Jurassic Melons)
Ducks (Mallard's Flippers)
Goats (Hircus Gourds)
Ostriches (Strithioberries)
﻿Pigs (Hogifruits)
Rabbits (Lepori Roots)
Sheep (Caprino Beans)

However all animals aren't made equal! So some plants required additional drops in order to compensate! These crops include; Bovine Melon, Poultryberry, Hircus Gourd, Mallard's Flipper and Lepori Roots!

In order to obtain these resources, the crops must be placed in the new machine the Resource Processor. The recipes for which are;[/center]
[center] ﻿Bovine Melon -> Milk
﻿Pristine Bovine Melon -> Large Milk
﻿Poultryberry -> Egg (Brown or White, 50/50 chance of either)
﻿Pristine Poultryberry -> Large Egg (Brown or White, 50/50 chance of either)
﻿Hircus Gourd -> Goat's Milk
﻿Pristine Hircus Gourd -> Large Goat's Milk
﻿Mallard's Flipper -> Duck Egg
﻿Mallard's Flipper Leaf -> Duck Feather
﻿Lepori Roots -> Rabbit's Foot
﻿Lepori Brush -> Wool
﻿Caprino Bean -> Wool
﻿Hogifruit -> Truffles
﻿Strithioberry -> Ostrich Egg
﻿Jurassic Melon -> Dinosaur Egg

I don't intend to break the gameplay procession though! So to compensate, Strithioberries will required you to learn the Ostrich Incubator recipe before you can purchase them, and Jurassic Melons will require you to have donated a dinosaur egg to the museum! All others will be available in their respective seasons at Marnie's!

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/rmGSgkzb/installation.png[/img]
1. ﻿Install latest versions of SMAPI, Content Patcher, Extra Machine Configs, and Machine Terrain Framework.
2. Download mod
3. Unzip the mod and place in your Stardew mods folder
4. Run game using SMAPI.

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/vBPmGqKc/compatibility.png[/img]
No known incompatibilities, compatibility for specific mods are planned for the future!
